subject.title: fix(agents): apply stale-run liveness check to aborted subagent orphan recovery

question: Is the durable restart-path integration evidence sufficient for this difficult stale-recovery scenario, or must the contributor provide a real exact-head gateway restart before merge?
rationale: The branch exercises real registry, task, session-store, liveness, retry, durability, and generation behavior, but external-PR policy requires real-setup evidence and the remaining mocked boundaries are the gateway and transcript processes.

options.title: Require live restart proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted exact-head gateway evidence shows an expired aborted run finalized and a fresh aborted run resumed.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the durable integration coverage as sufficient for this multi-hour restart scenario and continue normal merge review.

recommendation.title: Require live restart proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted exact-head gateway evidence shows an expired aborted run finalized and a fresh aborted run resumed.
